_source: Shaped from GitHub's REST documentation as summarised by web search on 2026-11-08 (docs.github.com could not be fetched from the build session). UNVERIFIED against real GitHub until the founder's run after Phase 2 (F22 T3.0, T4.8, foundation item 28); T4.8 replaces these with sanitized real responses. Values are made up. Page: 'Create an installation access token for an app', POST /app/installations/{installation_id}/access_tokens, answering 201. Since 2026-04-27 GitHub rolls out a longer stateless token format; nothing here assumes a length.
